beats.say: Taylor Swift's single Patient Zero spent a third week at number one.
Billboard says the song added a third consecutive week at number one on the Billboard Hot 100 chart.
Wikipedia shows the single was officially released on 25 September 2026.
Will you be listening to Patient Zero by Taylor Swift on repeat this week?
